_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ehl#5, and a FALSIFICATION of the key it names. The entry said 'Set TRANSIENT: true in LUBRICATION DYNAMIC'. There is no TRANSIENT key: writing it aborts at parse time in core/io/src/4C_io_input_spec_builders.cpp line 633 with 'Could not match this input', before any field is built (CLAIMEDKEY_FIELDS_BUILT=0), and 4C reports it under '[!] The following data remains unused:' while enumerating the parameters the section does accept — including the real key, ADD_SQUEEZE_TERM (bool, default false). That key is load-bearing: upstream ehl3d_mixed.4C.yaml sets it true, and turning it off makes the run die of SIGFPE inside the contact regularisation without reaching the result tests. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).

_mutation.note: remove the fabricated-key pathology: stop injecting TRANSIENT. CLAIMED_KEY_IN_DECK drops to 0 (a forbidden token) and the parse abort disappears, so the fixture must go red.
remove the squeeze-term pathology: leave ADD_SQUEEZE_TERM on in the third arm. OFF_ARM_ADD_SQUEEZE_TERM:true is a forbidden token, EXIT_SQUEEZE_OFF stops being 136 and the fixture must go red.
